thread.title: Dow Off Sessions Lows But Still Down 459 Points. Watch What Happened Now!

author: thestreet.com
title: Dow Off Sessions Lows But Still Down 459 Points. Watch What Happened Now!
text:
The Dow Jones Industrial Average was able to come up off of its session lows, but the index still fell 459 points, or 1.91% to 23,644 on the day.
The Nasdaq was the day's biggest loser, falling 2.74% while the S&P 500 dropped 2.23%. Facebook Inc. ( FB ) tumbled 2.75%, Apple Inc. ( AAPL )   was down 0.66%, Netflix Inc. ( NFLX ) declined 5.1% and Alphabet Inc. ( GOOGL )  was off 2.36%.
